the basal level of transcriptional activity is regulated by a spontaneous Ca2+oscillation that propagates from the cytosol into the nucleus.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the c-fos transcription is regulated by the serum response element, but not by c-fos CRE, in AtT20 neuroendocrine cells.
the serum response element is a target for spontaneous Ca2+ signals in the cytosolic compartment, whereas the cAMP/Ca response element is a nuclear target for Ca2+ signals induced by depolarization.
in AtT-20 cells, the c-fos gene is constitutively activated by spontaneous Ca2+oscillations through the SRE, and the Ca2+ response is amplified by the nuclear CaCl2clamp.
